## Alignment

| Left | Center | Right | Default |
| :--- | :----: | ----: | ------- |
| a    |    b   |     c | d       |
| long | longer |  wide | widest  |

## Inline formatting in cells

| Syntax   | Renders as     |
| -------- | -------------- |
| `**x**`  | **x**          |
| `[a](b)` | [a](b)         |
| a \| b   | an escaped bar |
